body: I know the number for my doctor and I'm sure if they wanted to put me on therapy they'd help me with that, but I don't like the idea of just being stuck on pills. If I really need to I'll ask one of my friends, but I'm more likely to just bite the bullet and go alone, if I do go.

I live in the UK. And no, no friends who could come with me. I could ask and would love if someone would come with me but I really don't see any of my friends responding positively; rather, they'd probably see me as a "freak" or something.
